tools.name: desk.list
tools.description: List HoldSpeak desk primitives of one kind. The desk schema advertises 18 primitive kinds; this tool operates on the 6 authorable kinds: notes, decisions, kbs, directories, workflows, and chains. The remaining 12 kinds (meeting, artifact, project, repository, recipe, coder, game, roadmap, story, workbench, layout, people) are managed through dedicated tools or are read-only.

The desk schema advertises 18 primitive kinds; this tool operates on the 6 authorable kinds: notes, decisions, kbs, directories, workflows, and chains. tools.name: meeting.start_capture
tools.description: Start a meeting capture through the configured HoldSpeak capture controller.

tools.name: meeting.stop_capture
tools.description: Stop the active meeting capture, optionally identifying the meeting to stop.

tools.name: meeting.delete
tools.description: Delete a stored meeting when it should no longer be retained.

tools.name: meeting.export
tools.description: Export a stored meeting as Markdown or JSON for sharing or archival.

tools.name: meeting.import
tools.description: Owner only. Import one recording or transcript file into a new meeting. The hub reads the file at path, keeps its own copy and transcribes it in the background; read meeting.get until transcription finishes.

path.description: Absolute path to an audio or transcript file the hub process can read.

title.description: Optional title; defaults to the file name.

occurred_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 date and time the meeting happened; defaults to now.

tools.name: meeting.run_intelligence
tools.description: Enqueue a fresh intelligence job using the disclosed summary route selection hash. Refuses when the hash is absent, stale, or the meeting has no transcript.

expected_selection_hash.description: Selection hash from the meeting planned_route read.

tools.name: meeting.proposals
tools.description: List follow-through proposals extracted from a meeting's intelligence run. Each proposal is a decision or action item waiting for Confirm or Drop.

tools.name: proposal.confirm
tools.description: Confirm a follow-through proposal, writing the decision record or action item through the kernel. Optionally amend text, owner, or due before confirming.

text.description: Amended text (optional; original kept when omitted).

tools.name: proposal.dismiss
tools.description: Dismiss a follow-through proposal without creating any record.

tools.name: steward.nudges
tools.description: List reviewer nudge proposals for a project, optionally filtered by state (proposed, sent, dismissed).

tools.name: nudge.send
tools.description: Send a reviewer nudge: post the comment to GitHub via gh pr comment. The text is the exact comment posted.

text.description: The comment text to post (required, non-empty).

tools.name: nudge.dismiss
tools.description: Dismiss a proposed reviewer nudge without posting. A 7-day cooldown starts.

tools.name: dictation.list
tools.description: Read the retained dictation journal, optionally paged and filtered by source.

cursor.description: Return entries older than this journal entry id.

tools.name: dictation.get
tools.description: Get one retained dictation journal entry by its numeric id.

tools.name: desk.snapshot
tools.description: Read one coherent snapshot of the durable HoldSpeak desk.

tools.name: desk.needs_you
tools.description: Aggregate needs-you items across all active project rooms. Returns {count, projects, items, next, coverage, complete} -- coverage names every expected source that was not observed.

tools.name: settings.hub
tools.description: Read the settings hub row facts: module state tokens for the settings truth table.

tools.name: decision_record.list
tools.description: List durable decision records, newest first.

tools.name: decision_record.get
tools.description: Get one decision record with sources, work, and revisions.

tools.name: decision_record.create_from_meeting
tools.description: Mint a durable record from a meeting decision.

tools.name: decision_record.create_from_desk
tools.description: Mint a durable record from an authored desk decision.

tools.name: decision_record.search
tools.description: Search decision records and their affected-work labels.

tools.name: decision.supersede
tools.description: Supersede a decision when a successor decision replaces it.

tools.name: pipeline.events
tools.description: Query observed pipeline events with optional filters.

tools.name: follow_through.board
tools.description: Read the Follow-Through board, optionally filtered by project, owner, or lane.

tools.name: follow_through.complete
tools.description: Apply a completion verb to a Follow-Through action card.

verb.description: Write-through board verb (`due` sets payload.due_at, HS-200-13).

payload.description: Verb data: until for snooze, to for delegate.

tools.name: follow_through.commit_decision
tools.description: Create an accountable commitment from an accepted decision.

tools.name: monday_brief.get
tools.description: Read the latest persisted Monday Brief; set generate to true when no brief exists and one should be composed.

generate.description: Generate the current brief when no persisted brief exists.

tools.name: monday_brief.generate
tools.description: Generate the current Monday Brief from durable sources. Repeated calls return the day's existing brief.

tools.name: monday_brief.shelf
tools.description: Set one brief item's triage state: acknowledged or deferred. Null returns the item to untouched.

item_id.description: A brief item id from monday_brief.get.

state.description: acknowledged, deferred, or null to clear.

tools.name: monday_brief.shelf_read
tools.description: Read the triage states of the latest brief's items, keyed by item id.

tools.name: scheduled_recording.list
tools.description: List all scheduled recordings with their current state, cron, and next-fire time.

tools.name: scheduled_recording.create
tools.description: Create a scheduled recording. Pass calendar_event_id to arm a calendar event (title/times/duration computed server-side, one-shot, enabled, fires 60 s before start). Without it, pass cron_expr + fields for a manual schedule.

title.description: Human-readable schedule name (ignored when calendar_event_id is set).

tz.description: IANA timezone name (default UTC; auto-detected for event-linked).

one_shot.description: Disable after first fire (default false; always true for event-linked).

duration_minutes.description: Auto-stop minutes (default 60; computed from event for event-linked).

enabled.description: Start scheduling immediately (default false; always true for event-linked).

calendar_event_id.description: Calendar event projection id (ce_...) to arm. Server computes all fields from the event.

tools.name: scheduled_recording.update
tools.description: Update a scheduled recording. Only supplied fields change. Re-validates cron and duration if provided.

tools.name: scheduled_recording.delete
tools.description: Delete a scheduled recording. Refuses if the schedule is armed or recording.

tools.name: scheduled_recording.cancel_armed
tools.description: Cancel an armed (counting-down) scheduled recording before it fires.

tools.name: ask.resolve_grounding
tools.description: Resolve grounding references and return their hydrated titles and character counts without running inference.

tools.name: ask.run
tools.description: Ask the desk a question. MODEL-INVOKING: rides the admitted RunLifecycle path. The result carries the receipt (model, provider, egress, actual_placement) so the caller knows what ran and where.

grounding.description: Grounding payload: meeting_ids, artifact_ids, refs, expand.

tools.name: ask.cancel
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight Ask invocation by its invocation_id.

tools.name: ask.keep
tools.description: Persist an Ask answer as a desk artifact. Not model-invoking.

tools.name: settings.get
tools.description: Read the current HoldSpeak settings. Secrets are redacted; _revision enables optimistic concurrency.

tools.name: settings.update
tools.description: Update HoldSpeak settings with a partial patch. EGRESS: an HTTPS calendar.sources is a list of {id, label, url, enabled} ICS sources, each fetched by the hub without credentials or headers; intel_provider and intel_profile_id are retired routing controls; _placement inference assignments and secrets cannot be written through this tool. Echo _revision from settings.get for optimistic concurrency; omit it for last-writer-wins. Settings are persisted immediately; a running HoldSpeak web server picks up the new values on its next settings read (no live-reload signal is sent from the MCP sidecar).

patch.description: Partial settings object. Only supplied keys are changed.

tools.name: coder.list
tools.description: List coder sessions. Steering verbs are out-of-scope for the MCP sidecar.

tools.name: coder.get
tools.description: Get one coder session by agent:session_id.

tools.name: coder.audit
tools.description: Read the bounded steering audit trail for coder sessions.

tools.name: cadence.status
tools.description: Read Cadence engine status: enabled, pressure, loop counts, policy count.

tools.name: cadence.loops
tools.description: List cadence loops. Omit include_terminal to exclude killed/closed loops.

tools.name: cadence.get_loop
tools.description: Get one cadence loop with its next action. MAY INVOKE MODEL when cadence intelligence is enabled; rides the admitted inference path.

tools.name: cadence.brief
tools.description: Read the deterministic Cadence morning brief.

tools.name: cadence.closeout
tools.description: Read the current Cadence closeout recommendations.

tools.name: cadence.history
tools.description: Read the Cadence nudge history.

tools.name: cadence.audit
tools.description: Export the full Cadence audit trail.

tools.name: cadence.snooze
tools.description: Snooze a cadence loop until a given time or for a number of hours.

hours.description: Hours to snooze (default 24, used when until is omitted).

tools.name: cadence.set_status
tools.description: Set the status of a cadence loop. The reply verb is intentionally absent from the sidecar: it requires the live agent-context pane delivery path.

tools.name: cadence.run_now
tools.description: Run a Cadence engine tick immediately. Local-only: projects loops, computes due nudges, returns them. May surface nudges ahead of schedule.

tools.name: cadence.apply_closeout
tools.description: Apply closeout decisions to cadence loops. Each decision names a loop_id and an action; returns applied/skipped counts.

tools.name: sequence.run
tools.description: Run a Sequence (chain) through the admitted inference path. MODEL-INVOKING. The result carries the receipt, steps, and artifact reference.

input.description: Input text for the first step.

tools.name: sequence.cancel
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight Sequence run by its parent operation id.

tools.name: workflow.run
tools.description: Run a Workflow through the admitted inference path. MODEL-INVOKING. Returns the receipt, node steps, and artifact reference.

tools.name: workflow.cancel
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight Workflow run by its parent operation id.

tools.name: memory.search
tools.description: Search the long-horizon memory store. Results are filtered by the principal's read permission.

kind.description: Optional kind filter: decision, decision_record, desk_decision, artifact, meeting, note, thread, action, project_item, workbench_item, or cadence.

tools.name: people.readiness
tools.description: Read the content-free People MCP capability and encrypted-store readiness. This never initializes the store or returns relationship data.

tools.name: people.relationship.list
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. List active relationship metadata from the encrypted People store.

tools.name: people.relationship.get
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Get one relationship with only shared-intent 1:1s, agenda items, requests, and commitments.

tools.name: people.grounding.get
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Build a source-preserving grounding bundle from manual shared-intent notes, open requests, commitments, and 1:1s. It does not invoke a model.

tools.name: people.relationship.create
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Create a direct-report relationship. Requires write capability; setup and archive remain Desk-only.

tools.name: people.one_on_one.create
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Create a notes-only shared-intent 1:1. Private prep, recording, transcripts, and inference are unavailable.

tools.name: people.agenda.add
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Add one shared-intent agenda item to a notes-only 1:1.

rolled_from_id.description: Optional open agenda item to roll forward atomically.

tools.name: people.note.create
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Create a durable manual shared-intent grounding note. The note is encrypted at rest and is not indexed or submitted to a model.

tools.name: people.request.create
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Record a shared-intent request. It remains distinct from a commitment until explicitly accepted.

tools.name: people.request.accept
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Explicitly accept one shared-intent request as a manager commitment. Private requests are refused.

tools.name: people.commitment.transition
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Apply done, dismiss, or reopen to a shared-intent manager commitment in the encrypted authority.

tools.name: people.one_on_one.brief
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Compute a read-time 1:1 preparation brief for a relationship. Returns open shared-intent commitments, agenda items, grounding note count, the last linked meetings with their open action items, decision records, and the count of un-linked meetings in the window. Never persists any data. Leader-private items are never returned.

tools.name: people.calendar.link
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Link a recurring calendar series to a relationship. The link is encrypted owner-selected evidence. Invariant P1: a series already linked to another person refuses with series_already_linked.

label.description: Event title at link time (owner-selected evidence).

tools.name: people.calendar.unlink
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Remove a calendar series link from a relationship. Idempotent.

tools.name: people.owner_alias.link
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Link an owner-string alias to a relationship. The alias maps a free-text owner string from action items to this person. Invariant P2: an alias held by another person refuses with owner_alias_taken. Reserved strings (Me, Remote, you) are refused.

alias.description: The exact owner string to map.

tools.name: people.owner_alias.unlink
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Remove an owner-string alias from a relationship. Idempotent.

alias.description: The owner string alias to remove.

tools.name: people.resolve
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Resolve a Watch identity string (GitHub login, Jira display name) to a People relationship. Returns ONLY the opaque relationship id -- never the name or alias (Article III). Returns null when no match.

identity.description: The identity string to resolve (e.g. a GitHub login or Jira display name).

tools.name: thought.adopt_note
tools.description: Adopt one existing Note as a durable Thought under exact source preconditions and this hub's default AI-context policy. Never invokes a model.

tools.description: Read this hub's owner-only default AI-context qualified refs and safe labels. Returns no Note bodies.

tools.description: List safe Note/Everyday-context attachment metadata for one Thought. Returns no context bodies.

tools.name: thought.reject_review
tools.description: Reject one exact receipt-gated review. This is an immediate owner action and never starts another model turn.

tools.name: thought.answer_and_continue
tools.description: MODEL-INVOKING: atomically add one question answer to the Note and reserve exactly one next refinement turn.

tools.name: thought.complete

tools.name: thought.resume

tools.description: List configured Reactions.

tools.name: reaction.create

tools.name: reaction.set_enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable a Reaction.

tools.name: reaction.process
tools.description: Project unhandled service events into matching Workbenches.

tools.name: thought.create
tools.description: Create one durable Thought. The server applies this hub's owner-configured default AI-context refs atomically; no context body or model turn is accepted.

tools.name: thought.adopt_note
tools.description: Adopt one existing Note as a durable Thought under exact source preconditions and this hub's default AI-context policy. Never invokes a model.

tools.name: thought.get_default_context
tools.description: Read this hub's owner-only default AI-context qualified refs and safe labels. Returns no Note bodies.

tools.name: thought.replace_default_context
tools.description: Atomically replace the complete hub-local default AI-context SET. Qualified refs and its own revision only; never invokes a model.

tools.name: thought.list_context
tools.description: List safe Note/Everyday-context attachment metadata for one Thought. Returns no context bodies.

tools.name: thought.refine
tools.description: MODEL-INVOKING: ask exactly one useful question about a durable Thought. The server loads authoritative content and context; this tool accepts no prompt, model, raw text, working text, or context payload.

tools.name: thought.reconcile
tools.description: Reconcile one known durable refinement result. Never dispatches or retries a model turn.

tools.name: thought.stop_refinement
tools.description: Durably suppress one exact refinement invocation, then best-effort cancel its physical call. Never retries.

tools.name: thought.attach_context
tools.description: Attach one qualified context ref. Refs and Thought cursors only; copied context is rejected.

tools.name: thought.detach_context
tools.description: Detach one qualified context ref. Refs and Thought cursors only; copied context is rejected.

tools.name: thought.refresh_context
tools.description: Refresh one qualified context ref. Refs and Thought cursors only; copied context is rejected.

tools.name: thought.answer_review
tools.description: Answer one exact receipt-gated review. This is an immediate owner action and never starts another model turn.

tools.name: thought.accept_review
tools.description: Accept one exact receipt-gated review. This is an immediate owner action and never starts another model turn.

tools.name: thought.reject_review
tools.description: Reject one exact receipt-gated review. This is an immediate owner action and never starts another model turn.

tools.name: thought.answer_and_continue
tools.description: MODEL-INVOKING: atomically add one question answer to the Note and reserve exactly one next refinement turn.

tools.name: thought.update_working
tools.description: Update the live working Note under Thought CAS. Never invokes a model.

tools.name: thought.complete
tools.description: Finish one Thought directly with a durable receipt. Never invokes a model.

tools.name: thought.resume
tools.description: Resume one completed Thought. Never invokes a model.

tools.name: inference.cancel_model_acquisition
tools.description: Cancel a model download before verification begins. This does not change model assignments.

tools.name: model_library.get
tools.description: Read the owner Model Library projection.

tools.name: model_library.download
tools.description: Start one catalog-pinned Model Library download. Assignments stay unchanged.

tools.name: model_library.add_to_library
tools.description: Add one server-detected artifact to the Model Library. Assignments stay unchanged.

tools.name: model_library.connect_hosted_model
tools.description: Connect a hosted provider. secret is write-only and is never returned, logged, or receipted.

tools.name: model_library.define_endpoint
tools.description: Define a provider endpoint. secret is write-only and is never returned, logged, or receipted.

tools.name: model_library.connect_paired_device
tools.description: Connect one already-paired device to the Model Library.

tools.name: model_library.use_model_file
tools.description: Add one model file from base64 bytes (maximum 16 MiB decoded). The hub stages and deletes the file; client paths and extra fields are refused.

tools.name: inference_assignment.summary
tools.description: Read the owner Assignment summary.

tools.name: inference_assignment.editor
tools.description: Read one server-decided, assignment-safe editor projection.

tools.name: inference_assignment.set
tools.description: CAS-set an ordered assignment chain. Exact command replay returns its original receipt.

tools.name: inference_assignment.preview_use_default
tools.description: Preview the server-resolved default before a bound clear operation.

tools.name: inference_assignment.clear
tools.description: CAS-clear an assignment. Exact command replay returns its original receipt.

tools.name: concierge.detect
tools.description: Detect every engine: LAN endpoints, local files, cloud keys present, presets not yet downloaded.

tools.name: concierge.propose
tools.description: Propose one engine set for the seven capability groups.

tools.name: concierge.probe
tools.description: Probe one engine. LAN/local always probes; cloud only with generate:true.

generate.description: Pass true for a cloud engine to perform an explicit one-token probe (cost: 1 token).

tools.name: concierge.apply
tools.description: Apply the engine set. Refuses if any group is WAITING and not OFF.

tools.name: concierge.download
tools.description: Start a preset download. Returns the job id and a progress shape.

tools.name: door.get
tools.description: Read the Dashboard Door aggregate projection.

tools.name: door.add_item
tools.description: Add an action item to the Dashboard Door. Creates a follow-through card with the given task, optional owner, and optional due date.

source_type.description: Source kind (default: thread when invoked from chat).

tools.name: thread.set_status
tools.description: Set the persistent status line shown in the thread head. The text is persisted across turns and visible on next load.

tools.name: project.list
tools.description: List all projects. Optionally include archived projects.

tools.name: project.get
tools.description: Get one project by id.

tools.name: project.get_room
tools.description: Get the coherent room projection for one project (identity, items, meetings, resources, changes, review, needsYou, sources, health, sinceRead, decisions, commitments, target).

tools.name: project.create
tools.description: Create a new project. Returns the created project with command envelope.

command_id.description: Caller-supplied idempotency key. Generated if absent; always returned.

tools.name: project.update
tools.description: Patch a project's fields. Accepts expected_revision for optimistic concurrency.

patch.description: Fields to update (name, description, keywords, lifecycle, purpose, etc.).

expected_revision.description: Optimistic concurrency guard. Refuses stale typed if mismatched.

tools.name: project.archive
tools.description: Archive a project (soft-delete). Accepts expected_revision.

tools.name: project.restore
tools.description: Restore an archived project. Accepts expected_revision.

tools.name: project.link
tools.description: Associate a meeting with a project. Accepts expected_revision.

tools.name: project.unlink
tools.description: Disassociate a meeting from a project. Accepts expected_revision.

tools.name: project.open_review
tools.description: Open a deterministic review window for a project. Returns the review (proposals, source manifest). One-open-review law: if already open, returns the existing review.

tools.name: project.get_delta
tools.description: Get the open review window or the honest empty state for a project.

tools.name: project.decide_proposal
tools.description: Apply a decision verb (accept/edit_accept/defer/dismiss) to a review proposal.

verb.description: Decision verb: accept, edit_accept, defer, or dismiss.

tools.name: project.accept_review
tools.description: Atomically accept an open review. Bumps project revision, supersedes undecided proposals.

tools.name: project.list_updates
tools.description: List updates for a project, optionally filtered by lifecycle (draft/published/superseded).

lifecycle.description: Filter by lifecycle: draft, published, or superseded.

tools.name: project.draft_update
tools.description: Draft a project update using the deterministic or model generator.

tools.name: project.update_draft
tools.description: Save the owner's edit of a draft update (body_md). Refuses published updates.

tools.name: project.publish_update
tools.description: Publish a draft update. One transaction: lifecycle -> published + project revision law.

tools.name: project.configure_steward
tools.description: Read or update the steward policy for a project. GET: omit all optional fields. PUT: supply at least one field to update. Includes unattended_enabled (bounded-delegation ruling). Emits steward.configured event on write.

eligible_effect_kinds.description: Effect kinds the steward may execute.

evaluation_cadence_minutes.description: Evaluation cadence in minutes (1..10080). Applied to all project watches.

tools.name: project.run_steward
tools.description: Start a steward run. Returns run_id IMMEDIATELY (MCP-003); phase execution proceeds on a background thread. Typed refusals: active_run_exists (STW-002), steward_disabled, cooldown_active.

tools.name: project.stop_steward
tools.description: Set the durable stop request on a steward run (STW-003).

tools.name: project.get_steward_run
tools.description: Poll a steward run: state, phase, steps, and receipts.

tools.name: project.steward.trigger
tools.description: Trigger evaluate_due + run_due NOW through the conductor seam. Unwired = typed refusal. Reuses the 163 same-watermark contract.

tools.name: project.setup.start
tools.description: Start a new durable setup interview session.

tools.name: project.setup.resume
tools.description: Resume (read) an existing setup interview session.

tools.name: project.setup.answer
tools.description: Answer an interview question in a setup session.

tools.name: project.setup.suggest
tools.description: Generate watch proposals for a setup session based on answers so far.

tools.name: project.setup.finalize
tools.description: Atomically finalize a setup session: create the project, activate selected+passed proposals as graduated watches, establish baselines. All-or-nothing.

tools.name: provider.list
tools.description: List configured providers (native + GitHub) with their capabilities.

tools.name: provider.github_connection
tools.description: Get the GitHub provider connection status.

tools.name: provider.github_discover
tools.description: Bounded discovery of GitHub repositories through the configured adapter.

tools.name: provider.github_validate_repo
tools.description: Validate a GitHub repository by owner/repo string.

tools.name: provider.jira_connections
tools.description: List all Jira connections (site+email pairs) and their status.

tools.name: provider.jira_add_connection
tools.description: Add a Jira connection by site and email (no credentials stored).

tools.name: provider.jira_connection
tools.description: Recheck one Jira connection status (switch + auth status probe).

tools.name: provider.jira_discover
tools.description: Discover Jira resources (projects, issue types, statuses) for a connection.

query.description: Filter text (substring match on key/name for projects).

project_key.description: Project key (required for issue_types and statuses).

tools.name: provider.jira_search
tools.description: Search Jira issues by JQL query.

enrich.description: Enrich each item with duedate, resolution, etc. via workitem view.

tools.name: provider.jira_validate_scope
tools.description: Validate a Jira project key (the validate_repo twin).

tools.name: provider.confluence_connections
tools.description: List all Confluence connections (site+email pairs) and their status.

tools.name: provider.confluence_discover
tools.description: Discover Confluence spaces for a connection.

tools.name: provider.confluence_validate_space
tools.description: Validate a Confluence space key.

tools.name: project.setup.clarify_jira_scope
tools.description: Clarify the Jira scope for a Jira proposal in a setup session.

tools.name: project.watch.inspect
tools.description: Get a graduated watch with its rules, circuit state, and evaluation history.

tools.name: project.watch.test
tools.description: Run a bounded, non-mutating read test on a graduated watch (ACT-002).

tools.name: project.watch.evaluate
tools.description: Manually evaluate a graduated watch: snapshot, diff, transitions, observations. Records watch_effects the Steward can act on (HS-200-43), keyed identically to a scheduled evaluation, so a manual run and the scheduler cannot double-mint. The first evaluation of a watch with no baseline is silent: it establishes the baseline and returns state=baselined with zero transitions.

tools.name: project.watch.set_rules
tools.description: Replace rules for a graduated watch (WatchCondition@1 + WatchAction@1). Optionally set evaluation_cadence_minutes (1..10080).

evaluation_cadence_minutes.description: Evaluation cadence in minutes (1..10080). Floor = 1 min (conductor tick), ceiling = 7 days.

tools.name: project.watch.pause
tools.description: Pause a graduated watch (stops evaluation).

tools.name: project.watch.resume
tools.description: Resume a paused graduated watch (state -> active).

tools.name: project.watch.retire
tools.description: Retire a graduated watch (ACT-009). Retains history, stops evaluation.

tools.name: project.suggested_sources
tools.description: List pending suggested sources for a Room (HS-172-06). Returns transcript-derived repo and issue mentions not yet added as Watch sources.

tools.name: project.add_suggested_source
tools.description: Accept a suggested source and create a Watch source on the Room (HS-172-06). Receipted (Article V).

reference.description: The source reference to accept (e.g. owner/repo or PROJ-123).

tools.name: project.dismiss_suggested_source
tools.description: Dismiss a suggested source so it never recurs for this Room (HS-172-06).

reference.description: The source reference to dismiss (e.g. owner/repo or PROJ-123).

tools.name: connection.list
tools.description: List all tool connections with their readiness state (HS-168-02). Returns the same shape as GET /api/connections.

tools.name: connection.recheck
tools.description: Recheck one provider connection (HS-168-02). Returns the refreshed tool entry.

provider_id.description: Provider to recheck: github, jira, calendar, models.

ref.description: Optional Jira connection ref (site|email) to recheck a specific connection.

tools.name: project.setup.select_proposal
tools.description: Select an existing setup proposal before testing/finalizing it; creates no Watch yet.

tools.name: project.setup.deselect_proposal
tools.description: Deselect a setup proposal before finalization.

tools.name: project.setup.test_proposal
tools.description: Run the actual bounded source test for a setup proposal, recording its result before activation.

tools.name: project.setup.clarify_repo_scope
tools.description: Discover or validate a GitHub repository for an existing setup proposal; omitted repo discovers authorized repositories.

tools.name: heartbeat.status
tools.description: Read the heartbeat sweep status: interval, quiet hours, last/next sweep timestamps, and whether the sweep is currently held.

tools.name: heartbeat.run_now
tools.description: Run one heartbeat sweep immediately. Evaluates due watches, refreshes the needs-you aggregate, and returns the sweep receipt.

tools.name: heartbeat.set
tools.description: Update heartbeat sweep settings. Accepts sweep_every_minutes, quiet_hours ({start, end}), notify (off|edge|every_sweep), and muted_projects.

muted_projects.description: Project IDs to exclude from notification aggregates.

tools.name: heartbeat.notify_test
tools.description: Fire one test desktop notification (owner-only). Returns {fired: boolean}.

tools.name: interview.get
tools.description: Read the current section, revision, saved facts, suggestion choices, and setup continuation.

tools.name: interview.change_section
tools.description: Revisit a section without losing prior context. New section tools are offered on the next user turn.

tools.name: interview.record_fact
tools.description: Record or correct a scoped fact using an exact quote from a user message. Keep assumptions inferred. This does not authorize any action.

tools.name: interview.suggest
tools.description: Save a useful suggestion connected to known facts. Describe evidence or hypotheses and prerequisites. Manual means conversational draft work; it does not install or authorize automation.

tools.name: practice_recipe.list
tools.description: List the prepared recipe catalog: the three versioned descriptors (meeting preparation, decision and commitment review, weekly Project update) with their input schema, source requirements, output, execution owner, effects, supported triggers, limits and acceptance criteria. Not the Agent catalogue -- that is recipe.list.

tools.name: practice_recipe.get
tools.description: Read one prepared recipe descriptor by id (preparation_brief | decision_review | weekly_update).

tools.name: practice_recipe.compile
tools.description: Compile a configuration plan for one prepared recipe against a Project: binds the qualified execution refs, the source scope and its observed coverage, the route policy, the limits and the acceptance criteria, and returns a typed gap for every missing adapter, unavailable prerequisite, stale descriptor version and unsupported trigger. Writes nothing and runs nothing.

project_id.description: The Project the plan is scoped to.

trigger.description: Which firing this plan is for. The same descriptor and version serves both.

version.description: The descriptor version the caller believes it is configuring. A disagreement returns a stale_descriptor gap.

tools.name: desk.list

The desk schema advertises 18 primitive kinds; this tool operates on the 6 authorable kinds: notes, decisions, kbs, directories, workflows, and chains. The remaining 12 kinds (meeting, artifact, project, repository, recipe, coder, game, roadmap, story, workbench, layout, people) are managed through dedicated tools or are read-only.

tools.name: desk.delete

tools.name: workbench.update

tools.name: workbench.delete

tools.name: workbench.update_item
tools.description: Update supplied fields of a Workbench item.

tools.name: workbench.delete_item
tools.description: Delete a Workbench item.

tools.name: workbench.list_runs
tools.description: List Workbench runs.

tools.name: recipe.list

tools.name: recipe.get

tools.name: recipe.run

tools.name: recipe.chat

tools.name: zone.file

tools.name: zone.unfile
tools.description: Remove a primitive from a Zone.

tools.name: zone.list_members
tools.description: List Zone members.

tools.name: kb.add_member
tools.description: Add a resource reference to a knowledge base.

tools.name: kb.remove_member
tools.description: Remove a resource reference from a knowledge base.

tools.name: kb.list_members
tools.description: List knowledge-base members.

tools.name: meeting.start_capture
tools.description: Start a meeting capture through the configured HoldSpeak capture controller.

tools.name: meeting.stop_capture
tools.description: Stop the active meeting capture, optionally identifying the meeting to stop.

tools.name: meeting.delete
tools.description: Delete a stored meeting when it should no longer be retained.

tools.name: meeting.export
tools.description: Export a stored meeting as Markdown or JSON for sharing or archival.

tools.name: meeting.import
tools.description: Owner only. Import one recording or transcript file into a new meeting. The hub reads the file at path, keeps its own copy and transcribes it in the background; read meeting.get until transcription finishes.

path.description: Absolute path to an audio or transcript file the hub process can read.

title.description: Optional title; defaults to the file name.

occurred_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 date and time the meeting happened; defaults to now.

tools.name: meeting.run_intelligence
tools.description: Enqueue a fresh intelligence job using the disclosed summary route selection hash. Refuses when the hash is absent, stale, or the meeting has no transcript.

expected_selection_hash.description: Selection hash from the meeting planned_route read.

tools.name: meeting.proposals
tools.description: List follow-through proposals extracted from a meeting's intelligence run. Each proposal is a decision or action item waiting for Confirm or Drop.

tools.name: proposal.confirm
tools.description: Confirm a follow-through proposal, writing the decision record or action item through the kernel. Optionally amend text, owner, or due before confirming.

text.description: Amended text (optional; original kept when omitted).

tools.name: proposal.dismiss
tools.description: Dismiss a follow-through proposal without creating any record.

tools.name: steward.nudges
tools.description: List reviewer nudge proposals for a project, optionally filtered by state (proposed, sent, dismissed).

tools.name: nudge.send
tools.description: Send a reviewer nudge: post the comment to GitHub via gh pr comment. The text is the exact comment posted.

text.description: The comment text to post (required, non-empty).

tools.name: nudge.dismiss
tools.description: Dismiss a proposed reviewer nudge without posting. A 7-day cooldown starts.

tools.name: dictation.list
tools.description: Read the retained dictation journal, optionally paged and filtered by source.

cursor.description: Return entries older than this journal entry id.

tools.name: dictation.get
tools.description: Get one retained dictation journal entry by its numeric id.

tools.name: desk.snapshot
tools.description: Read one coherent snapshot of the durable HoldSpeak desk.

tools.name: desk.needs_you
tools.description: Aggregate needs-you items across all active project rooms. Returns {count, projects, items, next, coverage, complete} -- coverage names every expected source that was not observed.

tools.name: settings.hub
tools.description: Read the settings hub row facts: module state tokens for the settings truth table.

tools.name: decision_record.list
tools.description: List durable decision records, newest first.

tools.name: decision_record.get
tools.description: Get one decision record with sources, work, and revisions.

tools.name: decision_record.create_from_meeting
tools.description: Mint a durable record from a meeting decision.

tools.name: decision_record.create_from_desk
tools.description: Mint a durable record from an authored desk decision.

tools.name: decision_record.search
tools.description: Search decision records and their affected-work labels.

tools.name: decision.supersede
tools.description: Supersede a decision when a successor decision replaces it.

tools.name: pipeline.events
tools.description: Query observed pipeline events with optional filters.

tools.name: follow_through.board
tools.description: Read the Follow-Through board, optionally filtered by project, owner, or lane.

tools.name: follow_through.complete
tools.description: Apply a completion verb to a Follow-Through action card.

verb.description: Write-through board verb (`due` sets payload.due_at, HS-200-13).

payload.description: Verb data: until for snooze, to for delegate.

tools.name: follow_through.commit_decision
tools.description: Create an accountable commitment from an accepted decision.

tools.name: monday_brief.get
tools.description: Read the latest persisted Monday Brief; set generate to true when no brief exists and one should be composed.

generate.description: Generate the current brief when no persisted brief exists.

tools.name: monday_brief.generate
tools.description: Generate the current Monday Brief from durable sources. Repeated calls return the day's existing brief.

tools.name: monday_brief.shelf
tools.description: Set one brief item's triage state: acknowledged or deferred. Null returns the item to untouched.

item_id.description: A brief item id from monday_brief.get.

state.description: acknowledged, deferred, or null to clear.

tools.name: monday_brief.shelf_read
tools.description: Read the triage states of the latest brief's items, keyed by item id.

tools.name: scheduled_recording.list
tools.description: List all scheduled recordings with their current state, cron, and next-fire time.

tools.name: scheduled_recording.create
tools.description: Create a scheduled recording. Pass calendar_event_id to arm a calendar event (title/times/duration computed server-side, one-shot, enabled, fires 60 s before start). Without it, pass cron_expr + fields for a manual schedule.

title.description: Human-readable schedule name (ignored when calendar_event_id is set).

tz.description: IANA timezone name (default UTC; auto-detected for event-linked).

one_shot.description: Disable after first fire (default false; always true for event-linked).

duration_minutes.description: Auto-stop minutes (default 60; computed from event for event-linked).

enabled.description: Start scheduling immediately (default false; always true for event-linked).

calendar_event_id.description: Calendar event projection id (ce_...) to arm. Server computes all fields from the event.

tools.name: scheduled_recording.update
tools.description: Update a scheduled recording. Only supplied fields change. Re-validates cron and duration if provided.

tools.name: scheduled_recording.delete
tools.description: Delete a scheduled recording. Refuses if the schedule is armed or recording.

tools.name: scheduled_recording.cancel_armed
tools.description: Cancel an armed (counting-down) scheduled recording before it fires.

tools.name: ask.resolve_grounding
tools.description: Resolve grounding references and return their hydrated titles and character counts without running inference.

tools.name: ask.run
tools.description: Ask the desk a question. MODEL-INVOKING: rides the admitted RunLifecycle path. The result carries the receipt (model, provider, egress, actual_placement) so the caller knows what ran and where.

grounding.description: Grounding payload: meeting_ids, artifact_ids, refs, expand.

tools.name: ask.cancel
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight Ask invocation by its invocation_id.

tools.name: ask.keep
tools.description: Persist an Ask answer as a desk artifact. Not model-invoking.

tools.name: settings.get
tools.description: Read the current HoldSpeak settings. Secrets are redacted; _revision enables optimistic concurrency.

tools.name: settings.update
tools.description: Update HoldSpeak settings with a partial patch. EGRESS: an HTTPS calendar.sources is a list of {id, label, url, enabled} ICS sources, each fetched by the hub without credentials or headers; intel_provider and intel_profile_id are retired routing controls; _placement inference assignments and secrets cannot be written through this tool. Echo _revision from settings.get for optimistic concurrency; omit it for last-writer-wins. Settings are persisted immediately; a running HoldSpeak web server picks up the new values on its next settings read (no live-reload signal is sent from the MCP sidecar).

patch.description: Partial settings object. Only supplied keys are changed.

tools.name: coder.list
tools.description: List coder sessions. Steering verbs are out-of-scope for the MCP sidecar.

tools.name: coder.get
tools.description: Get one coder session by agent:session_id.

tools.name: coder.audit
tools.description: Read the bounded steering audit trail for coder sessions.

tools.name: cadence.status
tools.description: Read Cadence engine status: enabled, pressure, loop counts, policy count.

tools.name: cadence.loops
tools.description: List cadence loops. Omit include_terminal to exclude killed/closed loops.

tools.name: cadence.get_loop
tools.description: Get one cadence loop with its next action. MAY INVOKE MODEL when cadence intelligence is enabled; rides the admitted inference path.

tools.name: cadence.brief
tools.description: Read the deterministic Cadence morning brief.

tools.name: cadence.closeout
tools.description: Read the current Cadence closeout recommendations.

tools.name: cadence.history
tools.description: Read the Cadence nudge history.

tools.name: cadence.audit
tools.description: Export the full Cadence audit trail.

tools.name: cadence.snooze
tools.description: Snooze a cadence loop until a given time or for a number of hours.

hours.description: Hours to snooze (default 24, used when until is omitted).

tools.name: cadence.set_status
tools.description: Set the status of a cadence loop. The reply verb is intentionally absent from the sidecar: it requires the live agent-context pane delivery path.

tools.name: cadence.run_now
tools.description: Run a Cadence engine tick immediately. Local-only: projects loops, computes due nudges, returns them. May surface nudges ahead of schedule.

tools.name: cadence.apply_closeout
tools.description: Apply closeout decisions to cadence loops. Each decision names a loop_id and an action; returns applied/skipped counts.

tools.name: sequence.run
tools.description: Run a Sequence (chain) through the admitted inference path. MODEL-INVOKING. The result carries the receipt, steps, and artifact reference.

input.description: Input text for the first step.

tools.name: sequence.cancel
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight Sequence run by its parent operation id.

tools.name: workflow.run
tools.description: Run a Workflow through the admitted inference path. MODEL-INVOKING. Returns the receipt, node steps, and artifact reference.

tools.name: workflow.cancel
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight Workflow run by its parent operation id.

tools.name: memory.search
tools.description: Search the long-horizon memory store. Results are filtered by the principal's read permission.

kind.description: Optional kind filter: decision, decision_record, desk_decision, artifact, meeting, note, thread, action, project_item, workbench_item, or cadence.

tools.name: people.readiness
tools.description: Read the content-free People MCP capability and encrypted-store readiness. This never initializes the store or returns relationship data.

tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. List active relationship metadata from the encrypted People store.

tools.name: people.relationship.get
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. tools.name: people.grounding.get

Leader-private prep is never returned. Build a source-preserving grounding bundle from manual shared-intent notes, open requests, commitments, and 1:1s. It does not invoke a model.

tools.name: people.relationship.create
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Create a direct-report relationship. Requires write capability; setup and archive remain Desk-only.

tools.name: people.one_on_one.create
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Create a notes-only shared-intent 1:1. Private prep, recording, transcripts, and inference are unavailable.

tools.name: people.agenda.add
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Add one shared-intent agenda item to a notes-only 1:1.

rolled_from_id.description: Optional open agenda item to roll forward atomically.

tools.name: people.note.create
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Create a durable manual shared-intent grounding note. The note is encrypted at rest and is not indexed or submitted to a model.

tools.name: people.request.create
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Record a shared-intent request. It remains distinct from a commitment until explicitly accepted.

tools.name: people.request.accept
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Explicitly accept one shared-intent request as a manager commitment. Private requests are refused.

tools.name: people.commitment.transition
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. Leader-private prep is never returned. Apply done, dismiss, or reopen to a shared-intent manager commitment in the encrypted authority.

tools.name: people.one_on_one.brief
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP. tools.name: people.calendar.link
tools.description: PEOPLE DISCLOSURE: local-owner access defaults to write; set HOLDSPEAK_MCP_PEOPLE_ACCESS=read or =off to restrict it. Only shared-intent material crosses MCP.
